articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
articles.description: Initial filings for unemployment insurance slipped to a seasonally adjusted 194,000.

articles.title: The 3 questions every AI investor needs to ask right now
articles.description: Your stock portfolio may have more AI overlap than you realize.

articles.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

articles.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
articles.description: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

articles.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
articles.description: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
articles.description: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

articles.title: Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
articles.description: Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

articles.title: Southwest Airlines cuts 2026 profit forecast on higher fuel
articles.description: Southwest Airlines became the third major U.S. airline this month to cut its 2026 profit forecast due to higher fuel prices.

articles.title: Markets are pricing in long-term AI winners. This veteran investor says history proves customers win more than innovators.
articles.description: Rob Arnott, chairman of Syzygy Asset Management, says the perceived AI winners of today may be far from reality.

articles.title: Why governments pulled websites offline over the decades-old PHP programming language
articles.description: Servers that use the popular PHP programming language were exposed to a critical security bug. Millions of websites have their data at risk.

articles.title: Oil is now flowing out of the Persian Gulf like before the Iran war. Why prices may still not come down anytime soon.
articles.description: Oil flows out of the Persian Gulf in October nearly returned to levels seen before the start of the Iran war, but traders remain wary about a fragile recovery.

articles.title: Moderna is about to release the trial results for its cancer vaccine. A lot is riding on this data.
articles.description: Moderna is one of the hottest stocks of the year because of its custom cancer treatment. Full Phase 3 data are set to be revealed this weekend.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.description: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: IBM’s stock falls as investors struggle to shake off July earnings miss
articles.description: Shares in International Business Machines declined 5% in Thursday’s premarket trading as investors digested the company’s third-quarter results.

articles.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
articles.description: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

articles.title: Why this JPMorgan strategist thinks the stock market’s tailspin might have run its course
articles.description: Hedge fund positioning has lightened considerably since its recent September peak, and JPMorgan strategists deduce from this that downside for stocks is now limited.

articles.title: American Airlines forecasts bigger loss in 2026 on fuel spike, plans to slow growth next year
articles.description: It's the fourth major U.S. carrier to cut its 2026 forecast this month because of a spike in fuel costs.

articles.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

articles.title: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
articles.description: CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.description: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce
articles.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.

articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.description: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $82,000 as markets go risk off on AI selloff, oil surge
articles.description: South Korea's Kospi tumbled 3.5% overnight, and oil gained nearly 3% on renewed Middle East hostilities.
